title: Instant Store Cosmetics
summary: Purchased cosmetics now appear immediately and color cosmetics always have a visible default.

changes.text: Store purchases, activation changes, and color updates now refresh cosmetic displays immediately, while color cosmetics use the Stargazer preset until a coach chooses another color.

title: Historical Match Stat Corrections
summary: Admins can accurately correct Pokemon appearances and K/D records for historical matches.

changes.text: Season 5-9 match result editors can select any Pokemon in the database when correcting historical stats, while other seasons remain restricted to team rosters.

title: Faster Matchup Selection
summary: Matchup Prep now loads schedule choices in smaller, faster steps.

changes.text: Selecting a division now loads only its week numbers, and selecting a week loads only that week's matchups instead of the full division schedule.

title: Coach Milestone Cache Follow-Up
summary: Coach record milestones now reuse their large shared source dataset without exceeding the framework cache-item limit.

changes.text: The shared coach-milestone dataset now uses a bounded 60-second server-process cache, avoiding repeated record queries and oversized framework-cache warnings.

title: Divisional Records & Move Sources
summary: Season 6+ divisional record books, linked coach achievements, richer Move Usage sources, and faster record pages.

changes.text: Battle Record now has official-color record pages for Infinity, Stargazer, Sunset, Crystal, and Neon with Overall, Regular Season, and Playoffs scopes covering Season 6 onward.
Top-three PBO and divisional record holders receive coach milestone titles that link directly to the applicable record page.
Move Usage rows can lazily load game sources with matchup, coach, move-count, match, and replay context.
Short-lived caches and targeted database indexes speed up Battle Record, coach milestones, and Move Usage sources while keeping recent results fresh.
Move Usage appearance totals retain games with an empty saved move map and clearly identify them as having no recorded move commands.

title: Current Stats & Faster Public Pages
summary: Current-season leaderboards, match data-quality tools, and faster public page data paths.

changes.text: Leaderboards can switch between the current season and all-time coach and Pokemon statistics.
Admins have a Data Quality review queue for missing deciding turns, replay links, Pokemon rows, and invalid winners.
Homepage, leaderboard, season, and coach public datasets now use short-lived caching while account-specific content remains dynamic.
Season and coach queries now fetch scoped rows, leaderboard scopes share one Pokemon-stat scan, and targeted indexes accelerate common public reads.
The homepage column layout now uses CSS instead of browser resize observers and synchronization state.

title: New Logo Frames
summary: Three new animated and themed logo frames are available in the PBO Store.

changes.text: Inferno, Icy, and Chromatic Flow logo frames are now available for 375 PBO Coins each.

title: Team Name Comparison Search
summary: Coach comparisons are now easier to find by franchise name.

changes.text: The coach comparison picker now lists and searches the latest team names in alphabetical order while preserving career coach records.

title: Automatic Release Notes
summary: Website deployments and release notes now ship as one guarded workflow.

changes.text: Every Fly deployment must include a uniquely keyed changelog entry dated for that Pacific-time day, and the server synchronizes it automatically during startup.

title: Stats, Comparisons & Changelog
summary: A full statistics integrity pass, new comparison tools, clearer replay reports, and a deployment-backed website changelog.

changes.text: Compare up to four coaches or Pokemon with shareable season, division, match-phase, and forfeit filters.
Admins can create, edit, publish, draft, and delete categorized website updates from the new Changelog editor.
Coach records can switch between Overall, Regular Season, and Playoffs, while the comprehensive Pokemon leaderboard now includes wins and losses.
Match replays have a clearer visual hierarchy and separate Favorable Crits, Flinches, Missed Moves, and HAX Count statistics.
A Seasons 5-11 audit corrected invalid or orphaned stat rows, record calculations, revealed-item handling, and stale fantasy cache totals.
Battle Record calculations now reject malformed winners, apply the official Season 6 differential rule, and use qualifying matches for consecutive-season records.

title: Stats & Sharing Updates
summary: Expanded career records, clearer coach profiles, and richer Pokemon battle statistics.

changes.text: PBO Records now includes Overall, Regular Season, and Playoffs career records for wins, losses, and matches played.
Pokemon Battle Stats now includes Kills and Deaths leaderboards with Total and Per Game views.
Coach profiles keep overall records visible while Regular Season, Playoffs, and Revealed Item Tendencies can be expanded when needed.
Game Prep and PBO Stats navigation groups now organize their related tools in focused dropdown menus.
The retired 5-Match Survival Streak milestone is no longer generated or delivered.

title: Season 11 Fun Facts
summary: Public fun-fact records and the playoff projection tool now reflect the current league format.

changes.text: Pokemon and coach fun-fact pages now calculate and label their records from Season 11.
The playoff calculator uses the shared PBO ELO expected-score formula for matchup probabilities.
The Pokemon fun-facts cache was versioned so deployments cannot briefly reuse Season 10 results.

title: Readability & Match Prep
summary: A round of usability improvements for public pages on desktop and mobile.

changes.text: Selected Match Prep teams now show their completed division record beside the coach name.
Dense public-page metadata is larger and shared retro buttons provide a 44px minimum touch target.
Infinity standings and Fantasy leaderboard colors now handle saved division names consistently.
